examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

items.wordHook: 早(early) + 上(on top) → the early sun on top of the horizon: 早上(morning).

examples.chinese: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
examples.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

items.wordHook: 有(have) + 的(of) → the ones that exist: 'some' of a group.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

items.wordHook: Leather (皮) wrap (包) → a wallet is a leather wrap for your money.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

items.wordHook: 忘(forget) + 記(remember) → forgetting to remember: 忘記(to forget).

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳怎麼樣？你想再去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zài qù ma?
examples.english: What do you think about that café? Would you like to go again?

examples.chinese: 台灣的珍珠奶茶怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhēnzhū nǎichá zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about Taiwan’s bubble milk tea?

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 妳覺得怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think?

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: 妳想怎麼去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù?
examples.english: How do you want to get there?

examples.chinese: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
examples.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

examples.chinese: 可是我不知道怎麼走，妳知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu, nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: But I don’t know how to get there, do you?

examples.chinese: 我們去跑步，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù pǎobù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about we go running then?

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 這種小鉛筆怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎo qiānbǐ zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think about this type of small pencil?

items.wordHook: 怎(how) + 麼(suffix) → 怎麼: the heart in 怎 asks 'how?' when you're baffled.

examples.chinese: 那位客人的錢包丟了，非常著急。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén de qiánbāo diū le, fēicháng zháojí.
examples.english: That customer's wallet was lost, and he is very anxious.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 你唱的這首英文歌，聽起來真好聽，可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chàng de zhè shǒu Yīngwén gē, tīng qǐlái zhēn hǎotīng, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: This English song you're singing sounds really nice; can you teach me?

examples.chinese: 外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái hěn kěpà.
examples.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

examples.chinese: 這個麵包的名字叫「髒髒包」，聽起來怪怪的，可是吃起來很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège miànbāo de míngzi jiào "zāngzāngbāo", tīng qǐlái guàiguài de, kěshì chī qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This bread is called "dirty bread"; it sounds strange, but it tastes delicious.

examples.chinese: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
我在公園散步的時候，聞到了花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán sànbù de shíhou, wén dào le huā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: When I was taking a walk in the park, I smelled the fragrance of flowers.

examples.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，吸引了不少外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, xīyǐn le bùshǎo wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive and have attracted many foreign tourists.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
最近賣的新飲料很有特色，所以光臨我們店的客人越來越多。
這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們要去騎腳踏車／自行車。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yào qù qí jiǎotàchē/zìxíngchē.
examples.english: This weekend we are going to ride bikes.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都去學校跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu qù xuéxiào pǎobù.
examples.english: I go to school to run every week.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
examples.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

examples.chinese: 他常常幫朋友，是一個好人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāng péngyǒu, shì yí ge hǎo rén.
examples.english: He helps his friends often. He is a nice guy.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都有中文課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
examples.english: I have Chinese class every week.

examples.chinese: 這個杯子一百多塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bēizi yì bǎi duō kuài qián.
examples.english: This cup is over a hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸、媽媽有三個孩子，我最愛看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba, māma yǒu sān ge háizi, wǒ zuì ài kànshū.
examples.english: My parents have three kids. I like to read the most.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 我有一個英國朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Yīngguó péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a British friend.

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
examples.english: Well then, I must see it this weekend.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

examples.chinese: 友美，妳這個週末要做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: Youmei, what are you going to do this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 明天是友美的生日，我想送她一個禮物。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì Yǒuměi de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge lǐwù.
examples.english: It is Youmei’s birthday tomorrow; I would like to give her a gift.

examples.chinese: 我想買一些花和一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìxiē huā hé yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: I would like to buy her some flowers and a big cake.

examples.chinese: 我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。

items.wordHook: Combining 體(body) and 貼(stick): 體貼 means considerate, thoughtful.

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese: 請把洗衣機放在這邊，冰箱放在那邊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xǐyījī fàng zài zhèbiān, bīngxiāng fàng zài nàbiān.
examples.english: Please put the washing machine here and the refrigerator there.

examples.chinese: 這只箱子是以前奶奶留給我的，對我來說是很珍貴的禮物。
我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？

items.wordHook: A handy item for 箱(box) with suffix 子(child): 箱子 means box.
Repeating 婆(old woman) twice for emphasis: 婆婆 means mother-in-law.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
這家公司的工作條件和待遇都不錯，吸引不少年輕人來面試。
好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
想當節目主持人，具有好口才是最基本的條件。
他因為生活條件的限制，而放棄了出國留學的機會。
表情豐富、能模仿不同人物，是演員應有的基本條件。

items.wordHook: Combining 條(clause) and 件(item): 條件 means condition, factor.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。

items.wordHook: Radiating personal 魅(charm) and irresistible inner 力(strength): 魅力 means charm, charisma.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
在法律及法院之前，每個人都是平等的。
在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。

items.wordHook: Combining 之(of) and 前(front): 之前 means before, prior to.
Combining 青(nature's color) and 年(year): 青年 means youth.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
我們吃完早餐，就動身去舞蹈教室練習舞蹈。
明天一大早要動身出國旅遊，所以我在睡前先把鬧鐘調好。
這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
射箭看來容易，但想把箭射好，就得辛苦地練習。
擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。

items.wordHook: 也(also) + 許(allow) → it may also be allowed: 也許(maybe).
a 力(strength) shoves a coin into the 口(mouth) slot → 加(add to).
Combining 及(and) and 格(form): 及格 means pass.
a 糹(silk) takes 彔(carve wood) dye → deep and rich 綠(green).
Speaking earnest words of truthful 言(speech) to 成(complete) a promise proves someone is truly 誠(honest).
With a strained 𠂊(bound hand), a porter carries a heavy sack of 貝(sea shell) coins bearing the 負(load).
